name: saathi-frontend
description: Every Saathi front end: shared packages and the apps built on them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n navigator,desk,doctor,admin,family-web,demo-stage -c cyan,green,magenta,blue,yellow,red "npm run dev -w @saathi/navigator" "npm run dev -w @saathi/desk" "npm run dev -w @saathi/doctor" "npm run dev -w @saathi/admin" "npm run dev -w @saathi/family-web" "npm run dev -w @saathi/demo-stage"
